title: The derivative of the reaction forces C_q^T lambda as an option of the Newton Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: The Newton Jacobians of the implicit and static solvers contain C_q^T, but not the derivative of the reaction forces C_q^T lambda by the coordinates, neither the local nor the system-wide Jacobian; jacobianConnectorDerivative covers the derivative of J^T f of the connectors, not the constraints. Decided: newton.numericalDifferentiation.constraintReactionDerivative, False by default, adds it by a numerical differentiation of the reaction forces of each constraint, body and node with algebraic equations by its own coordinates, serially; measured on the constrained test models.
releaseNotes: newton.numericalDifferentiation.constraintReactionDerivative = True adds the derivative of the reaction forces C_q^T lambda to the Newton Jacobian of the implicit and static solvers, by a numerical differentiation per constraint; off by default, as it seldom saves iterations.
